paite: Huchi in ei ahatte'n, eimah kipahna zong lou in, ahatlouhnate hatlouhna i thuakpih ding uh ahi.
english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

paite: Eimah invengte chiat tunding leh ahoihna ding ua kipahsak i tum chiat ding uh.
english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

paite: Khrist in leng amah kipahna azong ngal kei a, "Nang hon taite taina ka tung ah atuta," chih gelh bang in ahi zaw.
english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.” Psalm 69:9

paite: Laisiangthou a kuhkalna leh khamuanna mu a lametna i neihtheihna ding un, nidanglai a gelh peuhmahte eite hon hilhna ding a gelh ahi uhi.
english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through patience and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

paite: Tu in kuhkalna leh khamuanna Pathian in, Khrist Jesu ah noute lungsim leh ngaihtuahna mun khat pu in hon omsak hen;
english: Now the God of patience and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus,

paite: Huchi a, lungsim mun khat leh kituaktak a Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa leh Pathian na pahtawi theihna ding uh ahi.
english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in Khrist in Pathian thupina ding a noute ahon kipahpih mah bang in, khat-le-khat kipahpihtuah chiat un.
english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, TR reads “us” instead of “you” to the glory of God.

paite: Tu in, pipute kiang a thuchiamte hihkipna ding in Khrist tuh Pathian thutakdan theihsakna ding in zeksumte nasempa ahong hita chih na kiang uah ka gen hi.
english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

paite: Azahngaihna ziak a Zentelte'n Pathian apahtawi theihna ding un, "Huaiziak in Zentelte lak ah ka hon phat ding a, na min pahtawina ding in la ka sa ding," chih gelh bang in.
english: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore will I give praise to you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name.” 2 Samuel 22:50; Psalm 18:49

paite: "Huan nou Zentel tengtengte aw, amite toh kipak un," achi nawn hi.
english: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.” Deuteronomy 32:43

paite: "Nou Zentel tengtengte aw, Toupa phat un, mi tengteng in amah phat uhen," achi nawn hi.
english: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.” Psalm 117:1

paite: Isai in: "Jesse zungzam ahong khang ding a, Zentelte tung a vaihawm dingpa ahong dingkhe ding hi; amah ah Zentelte'n alametna uh akoih ding uhi," achi lai hi.
english: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.” Isaiah 11:10

paite: Kha Siangthou thilhihtheihna ziak a lametna na hauhtheihna ding un, lametna Pathian, na gintak ziak un, kipahna leh kituahna chiteng in hon hihdim hen.
english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huan ka unaute aw, nou tungthu zaw noumau mah hoihna in na dim ua, na kihanthawntuah thei uh chih keimah ngei in leng diktak in ka thei hi.
heading: Paul Laikhak Ziak
english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” , that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in ahon piak hehpihna ziak in nou hon theihpih ding in koi kalkal hiam ah hangsantak in ka gelh hi.
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

paite: Zentelte kiang a Khrist Jesu nasempa a ka omtheihna ding in, Zentelte Kha Siangthou a hihsiangthou ahih ua, pomtak ahihtheihna ding un Pathian tanchinhoih lam ah siampu nna ka sem ahi.
english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huchi in Pathian nna ka sep lam thu ah Khrist Jesu ah kisaktheihna ding ka nei ahi.
english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

paite: Khrist in Zentelte thumangsak ding a ka thugen leh nasepnate zang a asepkhiakte lou ngal bangmah ka gen ngam ngal kei a,
english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

paite: chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte, thilhihtheihna ah, Kha Siangthou thilhihtheihna in Jerusalem khua leh akim gam a kipan in, Illirikum gam pha in, Khrist tanchinhoih gam chih ah ka hilh kimta; keimah hon zang a athilhih tuh huchi tel ahi.
english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

paite: Ahi, midang suangphum tung a lem ka hihlouhna ding in, tanchinhoih Khrist min loh khitna mun a gen lou in.
english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

paite: "Atanchin gen ngeilouhnate'n amu ding ua, za ngei nailoute'n aza ding uh," chih gelh bang in, gen ka tum zaw ahi.
english: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.” Isaiah 52:15

paite: Huaiziak in ahi, na kiang ua hong ka kikhelsak naknak.
heading: Paul Zin Sawmdan
english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

paite: Tu in bel hiai gam kim ah sepna mun himhim ka neita kei a, kum tampi na kiang ua hong ut in leng ka omta hi.
english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

paite: Spain gam a ka hoh chiang in ka pai kawm a nou hon muh ka kilamen ngal a, noumau toh kithuahkhawm phot in, maban ka paina ding ah noute'n na hon va khaksuk uh leng ka lamen ahi.
english: whenever I journey to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

paite: Tu in bel, misiangthoute nasem ding in Jerusalem ah ka hoh tadih ding hi.
english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

paite: Masidonia leh Akhaia gam a mite'n kipaktak in Jerusalem a misiangthoute lak a gentheite a ding in thilpiakte ape chiat uhi.
english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

paite: Hiai thilpiak in amau nakpi in akipaksak hi; amaute ding in leng bat ahi him hi; Zentelte'n Judate khalam vualzawlna akikoppih ualeh salam thil a amaute taksap awng ahuksak sam uh akilawm him ahi.
english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.

paite: Huaiziak in huai ka hih a, gah leng amaute diktak a ka muhsak nung in, noute hon tawn in, Spain gam ah ka pai zel ding hi.
english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

paite: Huan na kiang ua ka hong chiang in, Khrist tanchinhoih vualzawlna kim pu in ka hong ding chih ka thei hi.
english: I know that, when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

paite: Unaute aw, Pathian kiang a na hon thumsak na uah, hon thumpih teitei ding in Toupa Jesu Khrist leh Kha Siangthou itna in nget petmah in ka hon ngen ahi.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

paite: Juda gam a gingloute lak a ka bit theihna ding leh Jerusalem a dia huhna ka tawi misiangthoute kipahna lamtak ahihtheihna ding in.
english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;

paite: Pathian hoihsak bang a nuamtak a na kiang ua ka hong a, i halhkhawm vek theihna ding un.
english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

paite: Lemna Pathian na vek ua tung ah om hen. Amen.
english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
